triggerReason: The first GitHub-hosted CI run used a shallow checkout, so the build-time Evolution Log generator discarded committed Git-derived history and the v0.3.0 evidence card disappeared even though local full-history browser tests passed.
action: Made complete Git history authoritative while preserving committed Git-derived entries only for shallow or Git-less builds, deduplicated current entries ahead of fallbacks, and added a focused merge-order regression test.
outcome: The same committed evidence history is now available in full clones, shallow CI clones and packaged builds without fabricating a successful external run. Remote CI rerun remains the acceptance authority.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 30639268795 failed only the missing v0.3.0 browser assertion after 26/27 scenarios
